You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 19 of 50 (script duration 119.6 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E9: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
E10: When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
E11: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.
E12: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
E13: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
E14: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.
E15: When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
E16: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
E17: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
E18: When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.
Direct lead-in to E19: Picks up directly from Episode 18's devastating fire; Juliana and Alexander stand amidst the morning ruins of Blackwood cottage with her mother's surviving herbal book before retreating to an abandoned barn.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-4.5] SCREEN: Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.
[L002 0.0-4.5] ACTION: Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.
[L003 1.8-3.5] JULIANA (Sorrowful, Hollow): "This was our home."
[L004 4.5-9.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.
[L005 5.1-8.2] JULIANA (Emotional, Fragile): "My mother's book almost burned with it."
[L006 6.5-9.2] ACTION: Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
[L007 9.5-11.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.
[L008 11.8-15.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.
[L009 12.1-15.2] ELDER VILLAGER (Respectful, Sincere): "My lady. You cannot stay here."
[L010 15.5-18.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.
[L011 16.1-19.0] ELDER VILLAGER: "There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."
[L012 18.5-20.5] ACTION: The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.
[L013 19.4-20.4] ELDER VILLAGER (Gentle, Earnest): "Take it."
[L014 20.6-22.6] JULIANA (Hesitant, Humble): "We cannot ask the village to feed us."
[L015 23.2-25.2] ELDER VILLAGER (Warm, Grateful): "You saved my son's life."
[L016 25.8-28.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.
[L017 26.4-27.8] ELDER VILLAGER: "You saved mine, too."
[L018 28.2-30.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.
[L019 28.5-29.8] JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful): "Thank you."
[L020 30.8-34.5] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
[L021 31.2-33.2] ALEXANDER (Deep, Solemn): "We will not forget this kindness."
[L022 33.3-34.8] ELDER VILLAGER (Nodding, Earnest): "Neither will the village."
[L023 34.8-38.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.
[L024 35.5-37.4] JULIANA (Choked Up, Mournful): "Goodbye, Blackwood."
[L025 38.0-41.5] ACTION: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
[L026 41.5-44.2] SCREEN: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
[L027 43.0-46.0] ACTION: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
[L028 44.3-45.8] INFORMANT (Subservient, Urgent): "Your Grace."
[L029 46.0-49.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.
[L030 47.1-49.2] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Direct): "Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."
[L031 49.5-54.8] INFORMANT (Grave, Cautious): "Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."
[L032 55.3-61.4] SCREEN: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
[L033 55.3-61.3] INFORMANT: "Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
[L034 61.4-64.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.
[L035 61.6-64.8] INFORMANT (Earnest): "And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
[L036 64.8-70.6] SCREEN: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.
[L037 65.1-70.5] INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed): "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
[L038 70.6-73.3] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
[L039 70.9-73.2] INFORMANT: "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
[L040 73.3-76.2] SCREEN: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
[L041 73.5-76.4] INFORMANT (Grave): "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
[L042 76.2-78.8] ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
[L043 76.5-78.8] ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury): "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
[L044 78.8-81.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
[L045 79.0-81.0] INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn): "And everyone believes you are dead."
[L046 81.2-83.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.
[L047 81.5-83.7] ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating): "Then let them believe it a little longer."
[L048 84.0-85.5] INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense): "And when we have the proof?"
[L049 85.5-89.5] SCREEN: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.
[L050 85.9-88.9] ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute): "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."
[L051 89.5-94.0] SCREEN: Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
[L052 94.0-96.8] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
[L053 96.8-97.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
[L054 97.2-100.0] ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
[L055 97.4-99.4] JULIANA: "We have lost everything."
[L056 99.9-103.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.
[L057 100.4-102.6] JULIANA (Despairing, Broken): "I don't know what we will do tomorrow."
[L058 103.0-106.0] ACTION: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.
[L059 104.2-106.2] ALEXANDER (Soft, Steadfast): "Tomorrow, we begin again."
[L060 106.0-109.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.
[L061 107.3-109.2] JULIANA (Faint Smile, Emotional): "You make it sound so simple."
[L062 109.8-112.5] ACTION: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.
[L063 112.5-119.6] SCREEN: Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "The Duke's Secret War", "segments": [{"start_line": "L043", "end_line": "L050"}], "hook_line": "L043", "hook": "The realization that his mother is a prisoner in her own home immediately raises the stakes of Alexander's mission.", "hook_quote": "My mother is a prisoner in her own house.", "cliffhanger_line": "L050", "cliffhanger": "Alexander's declaration that Ashburg will remember its true master sets the stage for a high-stakes power struggle.", "cliffhanger_quote": "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.", "why_it_works": "It shifts the genre from survival to a classic 'rightful heir' revenge story, which is highly addictive for this audience.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "medium", "self_score": 9}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "The Duke's Secret War": total duration 13.0 s is outside 20-60 s

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
